import java.util.*;

public class Main {
static Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
static ListelectronicsProducts = Arrays.asList("Earphone", "Laptop", "TV", "Mobile Phone");
static ListhomeDecorProducts = Arrays.asList("Vase", "Lamp", "Wall Art");
static ListstationeryProducts = Arrays.asList("Notebook", "Pen", "Pencil");
static Listorders = new ArrayList<>();
static Map<String, String> customerProfile = new HashMap<>();
static String loggedInCustomerId = "";
static boolean isLoggedIn = false;
static double totalAmount = 0.0;

public static void main(String[] args) {
    while (true) {
        showMainMenu();
    }
}

// Main Menu: Login, Register, Exit
public static void showMainMenu() {
    System.out.println("\n--- Main Menu ---");
    System.out.println("1) Login");
    System.out.println("2) Register");
    System.out.println("3) Exit");
    System.out.print("Select an option: ");
    int choice = scanner.nextInt();
    scanner.nextLine(); // Consume newline
    
    switch (choice) {
        case 1:
            login();
            break;
        case 2:
            register();
            break;
        case 3:
            System.out.println("Exiting the application.");
            System.exit(0);
        default:
            System.out.println("Invalid option. Try again.");
    }
}

// Register a new customer
public static void register() {
    System.out.print("Enter customer name (3-50 characters): ");
    String name = scanner.nextLine();

    System.out.print("Enter email (must contain '@'): ");
    String email = scanner.nextLine();

    System.out.print("Enter mobile number (10 digits): ");
    String mobile = scanner.nextLine();

    System.out.print("Enter password (1 lowercase, 1 uppercase, and 1 number): ");
    String password = scanner.nextLine();

    System.out.print("Confirm password: ");
    String confirmPassword = scanner.nextLine();

    System.out.print("Enter address (max 300 characters): ");
    String address = scanner.nextLine();

    // Validate inputs (simple validation example)
    if (name.length() < 3 || name.length() > 50) {
        System.out.println("Invalid name length.");
        return;
    }
    if (!email.contains("@")) {
        System.out.println("Invalid email.");
        return;
    }
    if (mobile.length() != 10) {
        System.out.println("Invalid mobile number.");
        return;
    }
    if (!password.equals(confirmPassword)) {
        System.out.println("Passwords do not match.");
        return;
    }

    // Assign random customer ID (7 digits)
    String customerId = String.format("%07d", new Random().nextInt(10000000));

    // Store customer details in a profile map
    customerProfile.put("Customer ID", customerId);
    customerProfile.put("Name", name);
    customerProfile.put("Email", email);
    customerProfile.put("Mobile", mobile);
    customerProfile.put("Address", address);
    customerProfile.put("Password", password); // Store password

    System.out.println("Registration successful! Customer ID: " + customerId);
    System.out.println("Email: " + email + ", Mobile: " + mobile);
}

// Login an existing customer
public static void login() {
    System.out.print("Enter customer ID: ");
    String customerId = scanner.nextLine();

    System.out.print("Enter password: ");
    String password = scanner.nextLine();

    // For simplicity, we assume customer is already registered in the system
    // In real systems, you would check the password against a database or stored value
    if (customerProfile.containsKey("Customer ID") && customerProfile.get("Customer ID").equals(customerId) &&
        customerProfile.get("Password").equals(password)) {
        loggedInCustomerId = customerId;
        isLoggedIn = true;
        System.out.println("Login successful.");
        showCustomerDashboard();
    } else {
        System.out.println("Invalid credentials. Please try again.");
    }
}

// Customer Dashboard after login
public static void showCustomerDashboard() {
    while (isLoggedIn) {
        System.out.println("\n--- Customer Dashboard ---");
        System.out.println("1) View and Buy Products");
        System.out.println("2) Payment");
        System.out.println("3) Previous Orders");
        System.out.println("4) View Profile");
        System.out.println("5) Logout");

        switch (choice) {
            case 1:
                viewAndBuyProducts();
                break;
            case 2:
                payment();
                break;
            case 3:
                viewPreviousOrders();
                break;
            case 4:
                viewAndEditProfile();
                break;
            case 5:
                logout();
                break;
            default:
                System.out.println("Invalid choice. Please try again.");
        }
    }
}

// View and Buy Products
public static void viewAndBuyProducts() {
    System.out.println("\n--- Select Products to Buy ---");
    viewAndBuyFromCategory("Electronics ", electronicsProducts, 100.0);
    viewAndBuyFromCategory("Home Decor", homeDecorProducts, 50.0);
    viewAndBuyFromCategory("Stationery", stationeryProducts, 10.0);
}

// Helper method to view and buy products from a category
public static void viewAndBuyFromCategory(String categoryName, List<String> categoryProducts, double productPrice) {
    System.out.println("\n--- " + categoryName + " ---");
    for (int i = 0; i < categoryProducts.size(); i++) {
        System.out.println((i + 1) + ") " + categoryProducts.get(i));
    }
    System.out.print("Enter product IDs to buy from " + categoryName + " (e.g., 1,2,3), or press Enter to skip: ");
    String input = scanner.nextLine();
    if (!input.isEmpty()) {
        String[] productChoices = input.split(",");
        for (String choice : productChoices) {
            try {
                int productChoice = Integer.parseInt(choice.trim());
                if (productChoice >= 1 && productChoice <= categoryProducts.size()) {
                    String product = categoryProducts.get(productChoice - 1);
                    orders.add(new Order(product, "Confirmed"));
                    totalAmount += productPrice;
                    System.out.println("Added to your orders: " + product);
                } else {
                    System.out.println("Invalid product ID: " + productChoice);
                }
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                System.out.println("Invalid input, please enter valid product IDs.");
            }
        }
    }
}

public static void payment() {
    if (orders.isEmpty()) {
        System.out.println("No products in your orders.");
    } else {

        System.out.println("You have purchased:");
        for (Order order : orders) {
            System.out.println("- " + order.getProduct() + " (Status: " + order.getStatus() + ")");

Please enter a valid 16 digit card number."); return; } System.out.print("Cardholder Name (min 10 characters): "); String cardholderName = scanner.nextLine(); if (cardholderName.length() < 10) { System.out.println("Cardholder name should be at least 10 characters long."); return; } System.out.print("Expiry Date (MM/YY): "); String expiryDate = scanner.nextLine(); System.out.print("CVV (3 digits): "); String cvv = scanner.nextLine(); if (cvv.length() != 3 || !cvv.matches("\\d+")) { System.out.println("Invalid CVV. Please enter a 3 digit number."); return; } // Simulating payment success System.out.println("\nPayment successful."); System.out.println("Order ID: " + generateOrderId()); System.out.println("Amount Paid: $" + totalAmount);

        // Change status to 'Delivered' after payment
        for (Order order : orders) {
            order.setStatus("Delivered");
        }

        // Clear the orders and reset totalAmount
        orders.clear();
        totalAmount = 0.0;
    }

// Generate a random 12-digit Order ID
public static String generateOrderId() {

// Logout
public static void logout() {
    isLoggedIn = false;
    loggedInCustomerId = "";
    System.out.println("You have been logged out.");

// Order class to handle individual product orders
static class Order {
    private String product;
    private String status;

    public Order(String product, String status) {
        this.product = product;
        this.status = status;
    }

    public String getProduct() {
        return product;
    }

    public String getStatus() {
        return status;
    }

    public void setStatus(String status) {
        this.status = status;
    }
}

class Solution(object):
def convert(self, s, numRows):
"""
:type s: str
:type numRows: int
:rtype: str
"""
if numRows == 1 or numRows >= len(s):
return s

    L = [''] * numRows
    index, step = 0, 1

    for x in s:
        L[index] += x
        if index == 0:
            step = 1
        elif index == numRows -1:
            step = -1
        index += step

    return ''.join(L)
